scenario: 今天的基础设施赛道围绕一个问题：瓶颈到底在哪，先量清楚再动手。Red Hat 先看 KV cache 的工作集放不放得进 CPU 内存，再决定要不要加第二层存储。VecDBLens 发现向量库召回的上限常常卡在 embedding，而不在索引。SubGPU Pipelining 和 GC-MoE 在单卡和消费级显卡上把解码时闲时忙的资源错开用满。SoScale 按层输出挑 FP4 的缩放系数。Olifant 让投机解码的草稿几乎免费。美团则用单元测试和运行时日志给 AI 评审的结论判真假。

papers.title: Authenticated Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search in Outsourced Vector Databases
papers.authors: Yuanhang Zhou, Xinyi Zhang, Cheng Xu, Jianliang Xu
papers.abstract:
Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search has become a fundamental query primitive in modern vector databases for managing large-scale embedding data. To support growing vector collections, organizations increasingly outsource database management and query processing to third-party clouds. However, untrusted service providers may return suboptimal or fabricated results, posing a serious threat to ANN search integrity. Existing authenticated ANN approaches face substantial scalability challenges.
They typically require transmitting high-dimensional vectors for distance verification and rely on topology-agnostic authentication structures, resulting in excessive communication and verification overhead. In this paper, we propose VIDA, a novel and efficient scheme for authenticated graph-based ANN search. VIDA replaces raw vector transmission with compact vector commitments and employs an aggregated Inner Product Argument to efficiently verify multiple distance computations.
Furthermore, we introduce MeST, a topology-aware authenticated data structure that aligns authentication paths with graph traversal, significantly reducing structural proof overhead. Additionally, we design a quantization-aware authentication strategy that exploits distance bounds for pruning, reducing the number of exact distances requiring cryptographic authentication.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed schemes substantially improve the efficiency of authenticated ANN search, achieving up to a $6.6\times$ speedup in end-to-end latency and reducing data transfer time by up to 99.2% compared with state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary: 向量库托管到第三方云上后，云服务可能为了省算力少搜几个邻居，甚至篡改结果，客户端得能验证返回的近邻搜索是不是真的。现有做法让云把图索引上的遍历路径和沿途访问过的全部原始向量一起发回，客户端自己重算距离。embedding 动辄上千维，这份证明就大得离谱。VIDA 改发向量承诺，它的大小和维度无关，再用一个聚合的内积证明一次验证多次距离计算。配套的认证结构让证明路径贴着图遍历走，量化给出的距离上下界又能先剪掉一批点，这些点不必做密码学验证。和现有最好的方法比，端到端延迟最多快 6.6 倍，数据传输时间最多减少 99.2%。==验证开销大头在传原始高维向量，换成承诺就省掉了绝大部分==。

deep_reading.title: Authenticated Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search in Outsourced Vector Databases

papers.title: Benchmarking tiered KV cache offloading on H100 GPUs in OpenShift AI 3.5
papers.authors: Ramesh Doddaiah, Alberto Perdomo, Nathan Scott, Ashish Kamra, Michey Mehta, Yuchen Fama, Naina Singh
papers.abstract: Across our tests, CPU DRAM provided the first and most efficient extension beyond GPU HBM. Local NVMe delivered the lowest secondary-tier latency and is well suited to single-node deployments where cache locality can be preserved. CephFS introduced higher per-block latency, but its shared capacity, persistence, and cross-replica reuse became valuable in multi-node deployments and under high concurrency.
papers.summary: 长上下文的 agent 请求会一遍遍带着同样的前缀，KV cache 本可以复用，可显存一满就只能丢掉，下次重算。Red Hat 在 OpenShift AI 3.5 上把 KV cache 卸到 CPU 内存、本地 NVMe 或共享的 CephFS，并给出一个判断方法：某层存储的 p99 恢复延迟低于命中缓存省下的预填充时间，这层才值得用。在平均约 5 万输入 token 的 agent 负载上，Nemotron-Ultra-253B 的吞吐最多提高 5.8 倍。差别取决于工作集放不放得进 CPU 这一层。放不下时，只卸到 CPU 内存只有 3.3 倍，加上 NVMe 或 CephFS 几乎翻倍。放得下时，CPU 一层就拿到了大部分收益。多副本、高并发时，共享的 CephFS 能让各副本复用同一份缓存。==先看工作集有多大，再决定要不要第二层存储==。

papers.title: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization
papers.authors: Pengxiang Zhao, Xing Li, Hui-Ling Zhen, Weizhe Lin, Xianzhi Yu, Zhenhua Dong
papers.abstract:
Low-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet accurate FP4 quantization remains challenging. Practical formats such as MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4 pair a 4-bit floating-point payload with block-wise or hierarchical scale codes, making accuracy highly sensitive to how each local distribution is scaled.
Default maximum-absolute-value scaling preserves dynamic range, but can spend scarce FP4 levels on rarely occupied outlier regions and leave dense tensor values poorly resolved. Existing scale-search methods minimize local element-wise reconstruction error, optimizing tensor fidelity rather than layer-output fidelity. We propose SoScale, a second-order weight scale-code search method for hierarchical FP4 quantization.
SoScale searches hardware-valid scale codes under a Hessian-aware layer reconstruction objective and couples this search with GPTQ-style error recovery, selecting scales by their impact on layer outputs. Across Qwen3 models, SoScale consistently reduces downstream quantization degradation under MXFP4, NVFP4, and HiF4.
papers.summary: FP4 量化每个数只有 16 个可选值，每块数据配一个缩放系数，决定这些格点落在哪。默认按块内最大绝对值缩放，离群值会把格子撑开。作者在 Qwen3-8B 的一个真实权重块里看到，最外面两个格点一个值都没分到，零附近密集的大多数值反而分辨率不够。已有的缩放搜索按逐元素重建误差挑系数，看的是权重本身像不像，而不是这一层的输出像不像。SoScale 只在硬件允许的缩放码里搜索，用 Hessian 加权的层输出误差来挑，并和 GPTQ 式的误差补偿交替进行，前一块的误差由后面的块吸收。在 Qwen3 的两个模型和三种 FP4 格式上，它每组平均分都最好，Qwen3-14B 在 MXFP4 下保住了 BF16 平均准确率的 97.17%。==缩放系数该按层输出来挑，只看权重误差挑不准==。

deep_reading.title: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization

papers.title: VecDBLens: An Evaluatology-Based Framework for Vector Database Diagnosis
papers.authors: Yutong Zhou, Guoxin Kang, Wenxin Zhou, Haoyu He, Yuedong Zhu, Lei Wang, Wanling Gao, Fanda Fan, Jianfeng Zhan
papers.abstract:
Vector databases are increasingly deployed as retrieval pipelines in which representation, indexing, and query-time execution jointly determine accuracy, throughput, and cost. Existing vector database evaluations primarily focus on indexing while treating embeddings as fixed inputs and ignoring the role of query-time execution, making it difficult to decide whether a bottleneck should be addressed by changing the embedding model, the index, or the query-processing functions.
To address the above limitation, we introduce VecDBLens, an Evaluatology-based framework that treats the function under diagnosis as an evaluated object and all remaining dataset, workload, parameter, and runtime factors as matched evaluation conditions. VecDBLens attributes performance differences to individual evaluated objects through comparisons under matched evaluation conditions, summarizing their performance and stability across multiple datasets and workloads.
It further analyzes interactions among objects using analysis of variance (ANOVA), thereby turning vector database benchmarking from leaderboard ranking into a reproducible diagnostic procedure. VecDBLens reveals two key insights. First, retrieval performance is fundamentally upper-bounded by embedding quality, revealing that many apparent indexing failures are therefore representation-side limitations.
Second, stronger index parameterization is not always beneficial: overly aggressive configurations can reshape neighborhood topology and cause recall regression. These results challenge the common practice of evaluating vector databases primarily through indexing and show that real-world limitations arise from constraints across retrieval functions rather than any single function alone.
VecDBLens provides a principled basis for identifying the true performance drivers of vector databases and for guiding their design in practical applications.
papers.summary: 向量库召回不好时，大家第一反应是调索引，但索引能找回的上限是 embedding 定的。作者在 VisualNews 上用 SigLIP2 做精确的暴力搜索，按距离找出的最近图片里，只有 2.04% 是标注里配对的那张。相比之下，HNSW 和 CAGRA 这类图索引几乎能保住精确搜索的全部召回。候选池扩大时，Qwen3-VL 平均还保住 72.3% 的召回，SigLIP2 只剩 33.2%。VecDBLens 的做法是每次只换一个对象，比如 embedding 模型、索引或查询处理，其余数据、负载和参数全部固定，再用方差分析看它们之间怎么相互影响。它还发现索引参数调得太猛会改变邻居结构，带过滤条件的查询召回反而下降。==召回上不去时，先查 embedding，很多看似索引的问题出在表示上==。

papers.title: Snoopie: A Multi-GPU Communication Profiler and Visualizer
papers.authors: Mohammad Kefah Taha Issa, Muhammad Aditya Sasongko, Ilyas Turimbetov, Javid Baydamirli, Doğan Sağbili, Didem Unat
papers.abstract:
With data movement becoming one of the most expensive bottlenecks in computing, the need for profiling tools to analyze communication becomes crucial for effectively scaling multi-GPU applications. While existing profiling tools including first-party software by GPU vendors are robust and excel at capturing compute operations within a single GPU, support for monitoring GPU-GPU data transfers and calls issued by communication libraries is currently inadequate.
To fill these gaps, we introduce Snoopie, an instrumentation-based multi-GPU communication profiling tool built on NVBit, capable of tracking peer-to-peer transfers and GPU-centric communication library calls. To increase programmer productivity, Snoopie can attribute data movement to the source code line and the data objects involved. It comes with multiple visualization modes at varying granularities, from a coarse view of the data movement in the system as a whole to specific instructions and addresses.
Our case studies demonstrate Snoopie's effectiveness in monitoring data movement, locating performance bugs in applications, and understanding concrete data transfers abstracted beneath communication libraries. The tool is publicly available at this https URL.
papers.summary: 多 GPU 程序扩展不上去，常常卡在数据搬运上，可现有工具看不清谁在搬什么。NVIDIA 的 Nsight Systems 只能提示 NVLink 上有流量，看不出是哪块卡发起的直接显存访问、访问的是哪个对象，NCCL 和 NVSHMEM 调用底下实际传了什么也看不到。Snoopie 基于 NVBit 做二进制插桩，跟踪点对点传输和通信库调用，把每次搬运对应到源码行和数据对象，并能从全系统一路放大到单条指令和地址。案例里，一个环形通信的 BFS 程序出现了本不该有的 1 号卡和 3 号卡之间的流量，对象视图指向一个只分配在 3 号卡上的标志指针数组，改正分配后多余传输就消失了。代价是插桩开销不小，在 NCCL 用例上尤其高。==它适合定位通信问题，不适合常驻生产==。

papers.title: SubGPU Pipelining: Intra-GPU Fine-Grained Spatial Parallelism for LLM Inference
papers.authors: Muralidhar Andoorveedu, Marius Juston, Tingkai Liu, Sanjay Patel
papers.abstract:
Large language model (LLM) decode is dominated by short, predominantly memory-bound kernels that make bursty use of on-chip execution resources and memory bandwidth. This paper introduces SubGPU Pipelining, a fine-grained, intra-GPU spatial execution model that cuts an operator graph into ordered contiguous segments, binds those segments to spatial stages backed by disjoint streaming-multiprocessor (SM) pools, and streams microbatches through the resulting schedule.
Selecting the graph cuts, segment-to-stage binding, per-stage SM allocation, and microbatch size is a coupled optimization problem: each choice changes the overlap pattern, shared-resource contention, cache state, and execution times of the others.
We evaluate SubGPU Pipelining through both simulation and silicon experiment using the GPT-OSS 120B workload with 32-GPU B200 deployment settings. The analytical shared-resource simulator searches across SubGPU pipeline structures and batch sizes to map the per-user/per-GPU throughput Pareto frontier.
At matched per-GPU throughput, the modeled SubGPU frontier provides up to 2.2x higher per-user throughput than temporal execution, and at matched per-user throughput it provides up to 1.9x higher per-GPU throughput. To test physical feasibility and further validate the simulation results, silicon experiments are performed, using one B200 GPU to emulate a 32-GPU B200 deployment.
The experiment evaluates one selected two-stage pipeline configuration at global batch 2,048 using CUDA Green Contexts and TensorRT-LLM kernels. Results show that SubGPU Pipelining improves mean DRAM read-plus-write throughput from 71.8% to 83.6% of peak, and reduces the 36-layer decoder iteration time by 10.33%.
papers.summary: 大模型 decode 由一串很短的 kernel 组成，大多受显存带宽限制。它们一个接一个独占整张卡执行，算力和带宽就时闲时忙，带宽打满时还有很多 SM 空着。SubGPU Pipelining 在一张卡内部做流水线：把算子图切成几段连续的子图，每段绑一组互不重叠的 SM，再把一批请求拆成小批次依次流过，让需求互补的工作同时进行。怎么切、每段给多少 SM、小批次多大，彼此牵动，作者用一个模拟共享资源争用的模拟器来搜。在 GPT-OSS 120B、32 张 B200 部署的模拟里，每卡吞吐相同时，每个用户的吞吐最多高 2.2 倍。实测只在一张 B200 上验证了一个两段配置，解码一轮时间缩短 10.33%。==一张卡内部也能做流水线，把时闲时忙的资源错开用满==。

papers.title: GC-MoE on SM120: Overlapping Expert-Parallel Token Dispatch with Warp-Level FP8xFP4 Block-Scaled MMA on Consumer Blackwell
papers.authors: Yong Li, Haoyu Wang, Kan Liu, Tao Lan
papers.abstract:
Expert-parallel Mixture-of-Experts decoding is latency bound: each layer serializes a token exchange, a grouped GEMM over routed experts, and a combine, while only a few tokens per rank are in flight. Prior GC-MoE fused these phases into one persistent, Green-Context-partitioned CUDA Graph on Hopper (SM90) and datacenter Blackwell (SM100). This paper rebuilds the operator for SM120 (compute capability 12.0, e.g. RTX PRO 5000) over PCIe.
SM120 exposes block-scaled tensor cores only through warp-level this http URL::mxf8f6f4: no tensor memory, no two-CTA MMA, no cluster multicast.
We rebuild the kernel around a swap-AB warp-level block-scaled MMA with FP4 weights in the register A operand and FP8 activations in B, plus SM120-specific mechanisms: scale-byte selection through MMA immediates, a compact-weights path, an adaptive token-tile geometry, an expert-granular streaming dispatch with a batched bulk-pull engine and a 64-bit deduplicating pull cache, full-width BF16 returns drained by resident relay copiers over a position-major arena, and shared experts folded into the compute role.
On 8xRTX PRO 5000 over PCIe the operator is 1.522x and 1.387x faster than the FlashInfer CuTe DSL W4A8 MegaMoE and the Cake MegaMoE across 18 decode points (18/18 wins each), and 1.388x faster than Cake with shared experts fused; all 94 numerical cases and 752 per-rank checks pass, at cross-operator cosine similarity of at least 0.9999997.
papers.summary: 专家并行的 MoE 解码受延迟限制：每层都要先把 token 分发到各卡、再做专家的分组矩阵乘、最后合并回来，三步串行，每张卡上同时在算的 token 又很少。此前的 GC-MoE 把三步融合成一个常驻的 CUDA Graph，在 Hopper 和数据中心 Blackwell 上运行。这篇把它搬到走 PCIe 的消费级 Blackwell 显卡上，比如 RTX PRO 5000。这代卡的块缩放矩阵乘只能用线程束级别的指令，数据中心卡上的几项硬件特性都没有，原来的 kernel 无法直接用。作者围绕 FP4 权重乘 FP8 激活的线程束级矩阵乘重写了整个算子，并重做了按专家流式分发和结果回传。在 8 张 RTX PRO 5000 上，它平均比 FlashInfer 的同类算子快 1.522 倍，18 个解码测试点全胜，数值检查全部通过。==同一个融合思路换到消费级卡上，几乎要按新硬件重写一遍==。

papers.title: Towards Green Text Generation: Memory-Based Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract:
Speculative decoding accelerates text generation with large language models by letting a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large verifier checks in a single forward pass. We introduce Olifant, a draft model built on a memory-based classifier. It predicts the next token from a four-token window in under 0.3 ms on CPU, requiring no GPU, no backpropagation, and no accelerator memory. We measure throughput and energy under two verifier regimes on consumer hardware.
Without a KV cache, drafting is nearly free: a domain-matched Olifant model reaches 38.1% acceptance on EU legal text, delivering 2.43x throughput and 2.51x lower energy per token than the neural verifier model alone.
With a KV-cached verifier, itself a ~10x energy saver, drafting costs matter: a TinyLlama draft model halves throughput and triples energy despite high acceptance, whereas Olifant still yields 1.25x throughput and the lowest energy in the study (93 J per 100 tokens, 14x below the uncached baseline). We further show that KV caching decouples time from energy: verification of longer drafts raises power draw, shifting the energy-optimal draft length below the speed-optimal one.
Speculative decoding is not dead in the age of fast verifiers, provided drafting is nearly free.
papers.summary: 投机解码让便宜的草稿模型先猜几个 token，再由大模型一次前向验证。验证器用上 KV cache 以后自己就快了很多，草稿模型的开销就不能再忽略。作者在消费级硬件上测到，用 TinyLlama 当草稿，接受率很高，吞吐却减半、能耗翻了三倍。他们的 Olifant 草稿根本不是神经网络，而是一棵基于记忆的分类树，只看前面四个 token 预测下一个，在 CPU 上不到 0.3 毫秒出结果，不用 GPU，也不用反向传播。在带 KV cache 的验证器上，它仍能带来 1.25 倍吞吐，能耗是整项研究里最低的。作者还发现 KV cache 让速度和能耗不再同步：草稿越长，验证时功耗越高，所以最省电的草稿长度比最快的那个短。==验证器越快，草稿就越要接近免费==。

papers.title: When One GPU Isn’t Enough: Serving GLM-5.3 Across Two NVIDIA DGX Stations with vLLM
papers.abstract: Running a frontier-scale model locally means keeping all its weights in GPU memory; the largest models no longer fit on one machine. Two NVIDIA DGX Stations...
papers.summary: GLM-5.3 的 NVFP4 版本是一个 MoE 大模型，每个 token 只激活一小部分参数，但每个 token 可能被路由到不同专家，所以全部权重都得留在显存里。整份权重约 464 GB，单张 GB300 只有 252 GB 显存，放不下。NVIDIA 的这篇教程用两台 DGX Station 经 RDMA 直连，用张量并行把权重和计算一分为二，由 vLLM 对外提供一个兼容 OpenAI 的接口，同时打开多 token 预测、FP8 的 KV cache 和前缀缓存。压测编程类请求时，总吞吐在并发 16 时达到顶峰，到并发 32 反而下降，平均请求延迟拉到七分半钟，每个用户分到的速度也越来越慢。==本地跑超大模型时，并发不是越高越好，要先压测找到拐点==。

papers.title: 如何在“不能出错”的系统里使用 AI Coding？分布式存储实践与边界
papers.abstract: 本文结合美团基础技术部在 AI 评审、问题排查和自动化开发中的真实实践，分享 AI 能帮上什么忙、容易在哪些地方犯错，以及哪些地方仍需要人来把关。比「多写代码」更重要的，是让代码和结论经得起验证。
papers.summary: 美团做分布式存储的团队分享了在不能出错的系统里用 AI 写代码的经验。他们先算了一笔账：就算 AI 代码的千行缺陷率和人写的持平，交付量一涨，缺陷的绝对数也会涨。AI 评审擅长发现跨文件的不一致，还会自己构造畸形输入把崩溃复现出来，但它看不到代码之外的东西，比如人工运维流程，或者宁可让进程直接退出也不写脏数据这类有意的设计。团队把一次全仓评审的 117 个疑似问题逐条写成单元测试，在主干上失败才算确认：36 条确认，3 条被推翻，其余只能靠读源码确认或暂时验证不了。把运行时日志交给 AI 对回源码，找出的缺陷经人工确认全部属实。==AI 评审只负责找候选，测试和日志才负责判真假==。
